verdict.rationale: Bento offers a CLI with 50+ commands for scripting account management (subscribers, tags, broadcasts, sequences, transactional emails) plus REST API with key-based auth, which supports headless/CI usage. However, there's no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipeline examples, exit codes, non-interactive flags, or containerized/headless deployment guidance. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive/headless mode flags, exit-code/error handling for scripted use, and independent hands-on confirmation of CLI running in CI environments.
